title: Nought, nought, one.
html_source:
Mathematical/scientific thinking is more straightforward (Strandentwining Cable': Joyce, Flaubert, and Intertextuality
By Scarlett Baron).

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: 0, 0, 1 could also be an attempt to create unity from nothing.

In addition, the final number of AA001 could represent a primordial telephone number that allows Stephen to reach back to the Garden of Eden.
